CustomField.label: Promotion Applied
CustomField.description: A promotion (coupon) discounts this line: it has a Promotion price adjustment linked to a promotion. Set by RepriceQuotesPST when the quote's Coupon Code is applied or removed. Below Floor then compares Price Before Promotion (not the promotional net price) with the floor (PRC-18).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when a promotion discounts this line. The promotion discount doesn't count for floor price approval.
